CustomField.description: Master availability switch for the Form Template. When false, the formTemplate runtime treats the template as offline and renders the Offline Message instead of the form; existing Form Submissions are preserved and can no longer be resumed. Works alongside Start Date / Close Date as the always-on override.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to make this Form Template live and renderable. Uncheck to take the form offline immediately in every context (Flow, record page, Experience Cloud) without deleting the template or any submissions.
CustomField.label: IsActive
